title: InMotion Hosting Review 2026: Plans, Prices, Speed and Guarantee

meta._yoast_wpseo_title: InMotion Hosting Review 2026: Plans and Prices
meta._yoast_wpseo_metadesc: InMotion Hosting review for 2026: shared plan prices, the 90-day guarantee, TechRadar and HostingAdvice findings, pros and cons, and who it suits.
meta.rl_answer: InMotion is a steady host with a long guarantee. The best shared price needs a 3-year term.
meta.rl_faqs:
Is InMotion Hosting good? | TechRadar said its shared plans held up better than most it has tested. Pricing is middle of the road, per HostingAdvice.
How much does InMotion cost? | TechRadar reported the Core shared plan from $3.19 a month on a 3-year term.
Does InMotion have a money-back guarantee? | TechRadar reported 90 days on shared and WordPress plans. Confirm it on the live page.
Does InMotion include backups? | TechRadar said backups are not included on shared plans.
Does InMotion have a Black Friday sale? | Its homepage shows up to 70% off, valid through 1 December 2026.
